taskDescription: Drag each word into the correct blank to complete the statements about metabolic hubs.
textField: Three of the four metabolic hubs are glucose-6-phosphate, *pyruvate* and *acetyl-CoA*; the fourth is the pool of TCA-cycle intermediates. Because the step from the second to the third hub is *irreversible*, carbon from even-chain fatty acids cannot be used to make *glucose*.

overallFeedback.feedback: Pyruvate dehydrogenase irreversibly converts pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, so any fuel that enters metabolism only as acetyl-CoA (including even-chain fatty acids) cannot contribute carbon to gluconeogenesis — a rule with direct clinical importance in starvation and diabetes.
